name: web-lime-yellow-investing-site-with-hand-drawn-arrows-and-market-phones
title: Investing site with a big lime hero panel, hand-drawn black loop arrows, tilted market phones and bento feature cards
whatItIs: A white page with a lime rounded hero panel holding a black headline 'Invest for the Future' with a sparkle, a Download App button, a hand-drawn arrow looping around the phones, two tilted phones (market list and candlestick chart) with red Sell and lime Buy buttons, then 'Get the Most Out of Your Investments' with two cards (lime shape, ring chart), advantages with icons, a partners row, a dark app band and a trade section with floating stock cards.
whatItMeans: Energetic and friendly; hand-drawn arrows make finance feel human.
techniques: Draw loop arrows by hand over the layout.
Tilt phones over a lime panel.
Use lime for blobs and highlights.
Show partners as round logo circles.

vocabulary.definition: A sketchy arrow curling around content.
Devices rotated over a coloured panel.
